senses.gloss: † कठ् कठ् (a form of कष्ट् in कष्ट), i. 1, Par. To live in distress.
कठ कठ, m. The name of a sage, MBh. 1, 962.

कठिन कठिन, perhaps for कष्ट + इन (cf. कठ्),
 I. adj., f. ना.
 1. Hard, solid, Pañc. 190, 16; Bhartṛ. 2, 77.
 2. Cruel, Kathās. 19, 89.
 II. f. नी, Chalk, Pañc. Pr. 7.
 III. n. A pat, MBh. 3, 8484.
कठिनता कठिन + ता, f., and कठिनत्व कठिन + त्व, n. Hardness, Bhāg. P. 3, 26, 36.

कठोर कठोर, i. e. probably कष्ट + वर् (for वन्) + अ (cf. कठिन), adj.
 1. Hard, solid, Bhāg. P. 3, 19, 15.
 2. Full grown, Mṛcch. 115, 13.
 3. Sharp, Bhāg. P. 5, 13, 3.
 4. Violent, Pañc. 93, 1.
 5. Loud, Pañc. 248, 17.
 6. Hard-hearted, Pañc. iv. d. 62.

काठिन्य काठिन्य, i. e. कठिन + य, n.
 1. Hardness, Śāk. d. 58.
 2. Firmness, Rājat. 5, 440.
